title: Stale bridge: reply bare HTTP 503 so verify-trust says registryUnavailable
description: Mark 2026-10-23: (c) now, (b) later. When freshness refuses (no sync in 24h, missing or future stamp), git-vouch-trqp replies a plain HTTP 503 (Retry-After, short text body, no Trust Task document) instead of a trust-task-error, so verify-trust (trql-client: non-2xx = transport error) reports registryUnavailable, not a denial. Other errors keep the Trust Task error format. (b): ask OpenVTC to map retryable/unavailable trust-task-errors to registryUnavailable; held for Mark's conversation with Glenn Gore (see the held-notes memory). Do after the review-fixes workflow's bridge lane (wf_f518f833-7e4) releases git-vouch-trqp.
acceptance_criteria: Test against real verify-trust (tests/trqp/test_verify_trust.py): stale bridge -> verify-trust status registryUnavailable, exit as documented; non-stale denials unchanged; unit test for the 503 shape.
notes: (b) filed by Mark's request 2026-10-23: OpenVTC/verifiable-git-infrastructure#170 (treat retryable trust-task-error as registryUnavailable). If it lands, the bare-503 workaround can revert to a retryable trust-task-error.
close_reason: Bare 503 for stale registry; verify-trust reports registryUnavailable (203/203 trqp with verify-trust 0.24.0)
